title: v0.9.1 - AI Intelligence & Real-time Collaboration
description: This release introduces a modular AI prompt architecture, live dashboard updates via WebSockets, and a session-based activity feed for enhanced team collaboration and query reliability.

items.title: Live Dashboard Updates
items.description: Real-time, element-level collaborative updates using WebSockets.
details: Granular Broadcasts: Targeted updates for element additions, removals, and configuration changes.
Seamless Integration: No more full page refreshes when teammates edit dashboards.
Bandwidth Efficient: Only specific changes are transmitted over the wire.

items.title: Dashboard Activity Feed
items.description: A session-based history of dashboard changes.
details: Interactive Timeline: View a rolling log of the last 50 actions in the dashboard.
Hidden Shortcut: Toggle the feed via Ctrl + Click on the Save button.
Collaborative Visibility: See real-time activity from teammates alongside your own.

items.title: High-Density Visualizations
items.description: Intelligent handling of large datasets for better readability.
details: Temporal Aggregation: Automatic binning/bucketing for datasets over 500 rows.
Dynamic Density Rules: AI-driven detection of high-density data requiring bucketing.
Improved Time-Series: Refined SQL generation for temporal groupings.

items.title: Modular Prompt Architecture
items.description: A refactored AI engine with specialized domains.
details: Specialized Modules: Intent, Fetching, Processing, and Visualization are now separate logic units.
Prompt Scratchpad: Mandatory reasoning step to reduce hallucinations and improve logical flow.
Flexible Design: Easier integration for future specialized prompts (e.g., Financial Modeling).

items.title: Dialect Dictionary & Query Accuracy
items.description: Centralized SQL rules for superior cross-dialect performance.
details: 7+ Supported Dialects: Specialized rules for Postgres, Cosmos, Kusto, MongoDB, and more.
Query Stability: Dramatic reduction in syntax errors across different database providers.
Snake-to-Camel Translation: Automatic resolution of column naming mismatches in Cosmos DB.

items.title: Robust Intent Classifier
details: Multi-Goal Detection: Explicitly identifies Query vs Visualization vs Analysis paths.
Contextual Routing: Directs the AI to the specific module needed for the user's request.

items.title: Cosmos DB SQL Stability
items.description: Critical fixes for Azure-based analytical queries.
details: Aggregation Fixes: Corrected aliasing issues in GROUP BY and aggregate functions.
Sorting Stability: Prevented invalid input errors when ordering by expressions.
System Credentials: Injected necessary secrets for seamless dashboard-to-adapter connectivity.

items.title: API & Prompt Security
items.description: Enhanced performance and reliability for long sessions.
details: Data Truncation: Implemented a 10kb limit on intermediate results to prevent API quota hits.
Gemini History Management: Improved role-cleaning to ensure user-first, alternating chat histories.
RAG Pipeline Safety: Guaranteed skip of vector operations when embedding models are unavailable.
